title: Proposed operational policy defaults
description: Unapproved operating design; numeric alert/recovery/acknowledgment targets live solely in PERF-OPS/PERF-QUEUE under _meta/performance-budgets.yaml. Not contractual insurer SLAs, observed recovery results or an actual staffed rota.

entries.rationale: Single numeric source in performance registry; includes transaction log shipping and committed-outbox recovery.
entries.verification: Restore to isolated network, measure recoverable commit window and reopening time; reconcile external acceptance.

entries.rationale: Object/document recovery may differ from transactional database but cannot fabricate missing policy evidence.
entries.verification: Recover hashes and authorized document manifests; unavailable files remain explicit.

entries.rationale: Alert on paid unissued age while classifying underwriting and external dependencies.
entries.verification: Inject old verified receipt and assert owner notification with safe customer status.

entries.rationale: Potential duplicate financial/insurance effect requires prompt owned investigation.
entries.verification: Persist unknown state, stop unsafe replay and emit deduplicated alert.

entries.rationale: Proposed acknowledgment target is not a contractual customer resolution SLA.
entries.verification: Exercise primary then backup escalation; record actual timing.

entries.rationale: Platform coordinator; delegates money R12, partner R09, support R20, disclosure R11.
entries.verification: Incident has one coordinator and named functional owners.

entries.value: continuous primary and backup for live financial/issuance obligations
entries.rationale: Do not sell continuously without coverage for committed obligations; human rota remains pending.
entries.verification: Before launch record named primary/backup/timezone/hand-off and successful contact drill.

entries.value: on acknowledgment target breach contact backup, then incident coordinator; suspected disclosure also R11
entries.rationale: Automatic acknowledgment is not a human response; preserve hand-off evidence.
entries.verification: Simulate unavailable primary and confirm backup takes ownership.

entries.rationale: Durable queue age is separate from provider acknowledgment/issuance latency.
entries.verification: Delay worker and ensure age alert identifies local queue cause.

entries.rationale: Insurer/claims/fulfillment deadlines cannot be invented from internal alert targets.
entries.verification: Missing contracted due-time rule blocks affected live operation and identifies R20/R02 owner.
